description: Search the small archival-documents subset (~26 items: Islamic association reports, flyers, project documents — mostly Burkina Faso). Use French concept keywords regardless of the user's report language. Most have OCR text and an AI description. Call with no arguments to list all.

country.description: Exact country name: Benin | Burkina Faso | Côte d'Ivoire | Niger | Nigeria | Togo (accents optional). Corpus is mostly Burkina Faso/Togo/Benin

keyword.description: Concept keyword; substring match on title, OCR, the French and English AI descriptions, and subject (accent-insensitive)

name: search_documents
title: Search archival documents
